stem:
Meena says, “My house is 200 m from the post office.” What makes this a correct description of the position of her house?
A The distance 200 m is measured with a metre scale
B The post office is used as the reference point
C The house is bigger than the post office
D 200 m is a short distance

options.text: The distance 200 m is measured with a metre scale
The post office is used as the reference point
The house is bigger than the post office

teacher.key_rationale: A position is described by stating the distance together with the fixed object or point from which it is measured; here the post office is that fixed reference point, so B is correct. The other options concern the measuring tool, size, or length of the distance, none of which identifies the reference point.
